extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to demonstrate the issue by (1) scanning all 25 landform_id values in data/input.csv for duplicates (none: RG-01 through RG-25 each appear exactly once), (2) checking the workflow for any code path that could replicate rows or aggregate repeated surveys into the test (there is none; a guard raises ValueError on duplicate IDs before stats.ttest_ind is called), and (3) recomputing the group counts, means, standard deviations, Welch t statistic, Welch-Satterthwaite df, and Cohen's d by hand from the CSV. All recomputed values (n = 12/13, means 24.00/16.00, SD 5.63/4.01, t = 4.06, df = 19.8, d = 1.65, p < 0.001) match the report, so the selected result is consistent with exactly one entry per independent unit and the issue could not be demonstrated.
